subject.title: [Bug]: official @openclaw/signal depends on private-local-only openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime; external install fails registration (ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED)

question: Should `text-utility-runtime` become a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or should official external plugins be migrated to narrower existing/public seams?
rationale: Either route establishes a lasting external Plugin SDK compatibility contract; the correct public API scope cannot safely be inferred from the current internal facade alone.

options.title: Publish a narrow supported seam
options.body: Promote only the stable utilities needed by external official plugins, document and test the package export, then add an external-plugin import guard.

options.title: Migrate external callers
options.body: Keep the current utility facade private and replace each external plugin import with existing focused public SDK seams or plugin-owned helpers.

recommendation.title: Publish a narrow supported seam
recommendation.body: Promote only the stable utilities needed by external official plugins, document and test the package export, then add an external-plugin import guard.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has the only directly evidenced live external-install reproduction available in this review; a source-history owner should be added after the SDK ownership audit.
